passages.text:
USAID can and should ramp up support for increased media literacy and fact-checking initiatives, working with local
independent media and civil society groups that can promote media literacy competencies and support fact-based media.
A growing body of research on media literacy has demonstrated that media literacy competencies can build societal
resilience to disinformation, strengthen critical thinking skills, and instill a commitment to truth and common set of facts,
Media literacy efforts should be developed locally, and scaled up in and beyond educational institutions to reach
populations broadly, for example, in the workplace, in the civil service, in religious institutions. Efforts should reach diverse
sectors of the population (including the elderly, who may be new to the digital media landscape), meeting people where
they are and through trusted interlocutors.
